🎥🎬: Scary Movie (2026)

Twenty-six years after surviving the original masked killer, Cindy Campbell, Brenda Meeks, Ray Wilkins, and Shorty Meeks are pulled back into chaos when a new masked killer begins targeting them. The old friends reunite, only to discover that this killer has no intention of letting them escape the horror-movie madness a second time. 

As the group fights to survive, the movie turns its attention to modern horror trends, parodying reboots, remakes, legacy sequels, elevated horror, prequels, and just about every horror trope imaginable. The result is another completely unhinged battle between the characters and a killer who seems determined to keep the franchise going.

source_details.synopsis: Scary Movie (also known as Scary Movie 6) is a 2026 American parody film directed by Michael Tiddes and written by Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Keenen Ivory Wayans, Craig Wayans, and Rick Alvarez. It is the sixth installment in the Scary Movie film series and has been referred to as the spiritual sequel to the first two films. It stars Marlon, Shawn, Anna Faris, and Regina Hall. The plot follows Cindy Campbell and her friends Ray Wilkins and siblings Shorty and Brenda Meeks reunited when the same masked killer from the original film Scary Movie resurfaces.
